text: GAİN Medya A.Ş. is a company of the Anahat group: Anahat Medya A.Ş., founded by Selahattin Aydın, acquired GAİN Medya A.Ş. on 22 January 2025 for 450 million TL.
short: Gain Medya was bought by Selahattin Aydın's Anahat in January 2025

source.name: Cumhuriyet: Gain Medya kimin, sahibi kim? Gain Medya'ya neden kayyım atandı?
source.quote: Gain Medya, Anahat Holding'e ait bir şirkettir. Anahat Holding'in sahibi ise Selahattin Aydın'dır.

additionalSources.name: Anka Haber: Gain Medya'ya TMSF kayyım atandı, 3 kişi gözaltına alındı
additionalSources.quote: Anahat Medya Anonim Şirketi'nin, GAİN Medya Anonim Şirketi'ni 22/01/2025 tarihinde 450 milyon TL bedelle devraldığı
additionalSources.note: From the Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's statement quoted on the page, which sets out the share transfer and subsequent fund flows.
